name: VEICHI
name_zh: 苏州伟创电气科技股份有限公司
summary: VEICHI develops industrial automation and electric-drive products. Its motion-control portfolio includes servo systems, integrated mobile-robot drives, frameless and coreless motors, gearboxes and robot-joint modules. The company is based in Suzhou, Jiangsu.
